page: Amazon Web Services m6idn.12xlarge is a general-purpose, network- and storage-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz, delivering 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs with dedicated allocation and simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU provides a 54 MB L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and instruction set support including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, and SHA extensions. Memory capacity is 192 GB of DDR4 operating at 3 GHz, maintaining a standard general-purpose ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU.

Hardware bundling includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a 75 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. The instance contains no hardware GPUs. With 162.52 GB/sec uncached read and 69.5 GB/sec uncached write bandwidth across large memory blocks, combined with high-throughput local disk and substantial network fabric, data movement bottlenecks are mitigated for I/O-intensive workloads.

Benchmark results show balanced compute output with notable strengths in specific parallel workloads. Multi-core performance registered 15,879.0 on Geekbench and 46,460.65 on stress-ng, placing multi-threaded execution and image processing in the top 25% of tracked systems. Cryptographic workloads perform strongly, recording 43,656.33 on the PassMark CPU encryption test, assisted by hardware-accelerated instructions. In-memory data store tests yielded 45.48 million Redis SET operations per second, while static web serving throughput reached 40.53 GB/sec.

The qualitative resource balance positions this configuration as an efficient consolidation platform where compute, fast direct-attached NVMe storage, and network bandwidth must align without over-provisioning memory beyond the 1:4 CPU ratio. Tradeoffs center on the absence of dedicated GPU accelerators and reliance on DDR4 rather than newer DDR5 architectures. The instance fits high-throughput transactional databases, distributed caching layers, data pipeline stages, and demanding multi-threaded enterprise application backends.
description: Amazon Web Services m6idn.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, it includes 192 GB of DDR4 memory, 2850 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, and a 75 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance features AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions, achieving strong marks in multi-core metrics, image processing, and encryption benchmarks. With uncached memory write bandwidth reaching 69.5 GB/sec and Redis operations hitting 45.48 million ops/sec, the server handles intense I/O without requiring a skewed memory-to-core ratio. The absence of a GPU directs this instance toward CPU-bound and I/O-heavy operations rather than machine learning training. It suits distributed caching, transactional databases, static web delivery, and enterprise backend workloads.
